newsitem.title: USA: Banco Santander files $1 bln shelf with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Banco Santander files $1 bln shelf with SEC.

text.p: Banco Santander SA filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $1 billion in non-cumulative guaranteed preference shares and subordinated guaranteed notes.
Net proceeds from the sale of the securities will be used for general corporate purposes and to strengthen the capital base, the bank said in the filing.

Banco Santander, based in Madrid, and its subsidiaries are engaged in commercial banking operations in Spain and abroad and provide a comprehensive range of services to corporate and individual clients.
